elements.text: Flight crew's failure to ensure wings were free of ice or snow contamination
Attempted takeoff with upper wing contamination
Stall induced by upper wing contamination
Pilots' lack of experience flying during winter weather conditions
Recommendation to develop visual and tactile training aids for wing contamination
Recommendation to require operational control information disclosure for Part 135 flights
Recommendation to require CRM training for Part 135 dual-pilot operators
